findings.desc: CLAUDE.md:35 - REVIEW→TEST preflight still says 3 CLI gates (validate --channel / --concept / --lint), but the implemented preflight now also runs docs-drift (and conditionally codex-adapter) before TEST. The process doc understates required gating and can mislead agents into thinking TEST is reachable without clearing the docs gate.

packages/main/src/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.ts:577 and :595 - CHK-005 edge promises validate --channel accepts successful subagent_result and dispatch evidence, but smoke only covers a failing subagent_result path plus commit_author fallback; there is no positive dispatch/subagent_result acceptance assertion for checkDispatchEvidence/checkCommitAuthor, so the intended behavior is not meaningfully exercised.

packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:49 - INIT_CHECK-linked stories still accept checklist_add/update/remove from main because cwd authority only gates PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST, so active-story metadata can still drift before PLAN and CHK-001 is not fully fixed.
